title: FP8 SafeMode Calibration: blackbox auditing, canary plan, and multi-model stability validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: enable FP8 profiles for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2) behind a SafeMode gate that combines conservative activation heuristics, blackbox accuracy auditing, and a controlled canary rollout. Scope: build calibration pipelines that produce per-model and per-shard profiles, implement runtime guards (hysteresis and temporal smoothing), add automatic fallback paths to INT8/FP16 when drift or instability detected, and wire telemetry and alerts for regression detection. Non-goals: full model distillation or model architecture changes. Deliver a repeatable QA checklist and one-week canary on production traffic with automated rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration pipeline runs for target models and produces profile artifacts with metadata (scale factors, per-layer ranges, quant modes)
SafeMode runtime activates FP8 profile only when model and shard pass blackbox accuracy checks and telemetry thresholds
Canary rollout plan implemented with traffic ramp, drift detectors, and automatic rollback on high-severity regressions
End-to-end tests show <=0.5% relative metric degradation for key model families across sampled prompts vs baseline FP16 on a stable test suite
Dashboards show per-token latency, model quality deltas, and activation counts; alerts trigger for both quality and infra regressions
technical_notes: Calibration: run multi-seed synthetic and production-sampled traces to estimate saturation and outlier ranges; prefer per-op clipping over global clipping when variance > 2x

Profile selection: implement a weighted scorer that prefers E4M3 for layers with low dynamic range and E5M2 for higher dynamic range layers; encourage contiguous block selection to minimize kernel-switch overhead
Hysteresis: require stable activation (no threshold violations) for 10k requests and 4 consecutive 1h windows before enabling on a shard

Telemetry: capture per-request fingerprint (token distribution, max activations), per-profile error histograms, and layer-wise overflow counts; add SLO for quality drift detection at 0.3% with 95% confidence
Fallbacks: immediate per-request fallback to INT8 when intra-token overflow detected; soft-fallback for sustained drift (>=5% deviation over 30m) to FP16 with alert
Blackbox audit: run a held-out curated prompt set (300 prompts across categories) on every candidate profile; require p95 delta within acceptance threshold
Canary plan: 1% traffic -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 72h with automated metric gates; maintain cold start safety by limiting sequence length to typical 95th percentile during early ramps
Integration: profile artifacts stored in model registry S3 path with immutable naming and signed metadata for reproducibility
CI: add golden-suite regression tests that run on PRs touching quant code paths using small (<100 sample) quick checks to catch major breakages
Observability: tag activations with profile id, model hash, and shard id for correlation across logs, traces, and metrics
